The drawing shows an iminium cation. The nitrogen carries a positive charge and is bonded to a methyl group (Me), a phenyl group (Ph), and a CH2 group through a double bond (N=CH2).

This gives N-methyl-N-phenylmethaniminium, written as C[N+](=C)c1ccccc1. The SMILES is valid and matches the drawing atom for atom. There are no wedges, hashes or cis/trans bonds, so no stereochemistry is included.

SMILES: C[N+](=C)c1ccccc1
